seoTitle: Use the Long/Short Position Tool on TradingView
metaDescription: Learn how to activate TradingView's Long and Short Position tool to plan trades, set stop loss and targets, and calculate position size by risk.
intro: TradingView's Long and Short Position tool helps you visually plan trades and calculate position size based on risk tolerance, whether you're trading crypto, stocks, forex, or indices. This guide covers activating the tool, adjusting entry and exit levels, and using it for consistent risk management.

steps.heading: Activate the Long/Short Position tool
steps.body: Select the tool from your chart's drawing options to start planning a trade visually.

steps.heading: Set entry, stop loss, and take profit
steps.body: Drag the tool's levels to define your entry point, stop loss, and target price for the trade.

steps.heading: Use the risk percentage feature
steps.body: Adjust the risk percentage setting to manage how much of your capital you're willing to risk on the trade.

steps.heading: Calculate position size
steps.body: Based on your account balance and risk tolerance, the tool helps calculate an appropriate position size for the trade.

steps.heading: Review risk-to-reward ratio
steps.body: Check the calculated risk-to-reward ratio to see whether the setup fits your trading strategy before entering.

steps.heading: Save templates for consistency
steps.body: Save your preferred settings as a template so you can apply the same setup across multiple charts.

faq.question: What does the Long/Short Position tool do on TradingView?
faq.answer: It lets you visually plan a trade by setting entry, stop loss, and take profit levels, while calculating risk-to-reward and position size.

faq.question: Can I use this tool for crypto and forex, not just stocks?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool works across crypto, stocks, forex, and indices.

faq.question: How does the risk percentage feature help?
faq.answer: It lets you manage your capital by calculating position size based on how much of your account you're willing to risk.

faq.question: Can I save my position tool settings?
faq.answer: Yes, you can save templates so you can apply consistent setups across multiple charts.

faq.question: Is this tool useful for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes, it's designed to help both new traders and experienced analysts fine-tune their position sizing and risk management.
